description: Meeting report export: format and permission.

preconditions: The reader may read meetings in January to December 2026.
cases.inputs: actorId: <id of an active internal reader>; from: "2026-01"; to: "2026-12".
cases.return: A file named "bao-cao-cuoc-hop_2026-01_2026-12.xlsx" with content type "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet", holding the figures computed again at export time; the file carries only counts, rates and averages, never a meeting id, title, participant or content. An audit row (event report.exported, objectType "Report", no object id) records the actor, the period and the time.

preconditions: The reader may read no meeting in the period.
cases.inputs: actorId: <id of an active internal reader>; from: "2026-01"; to: "2026-03".
cases.return: A file is still built with zero counts and no averages, and the export is recorded in the audit log.

preconditions: The period is a single month.
cases.inputs: actorId: <id of an active internal reader>; from: "2026-11"; to: "2026-11".
cases.return: A file named "bao-cao-cuoc-hop_2026-11_2026-11.xlsx" for that month, and the export is recorded in the audit log.

preconditions: The start month is after the end month.
cases.inputs: actorId: <id of an active internal reader>; from: "2026-12"; to: "2026-01".
cases.return: InvalidPeriod; no file is built and nothing is recorded. The endpoint answers 400 MSG463: "Khoảng thời gian không hợp lệ. Chọn tối đa 24 tháng, tháng bắt đầu không sau tháng kết thúc."

preconditions: The database fails while reading the figures.
cases.inputs: actorId: <id of an active internal reader>; from: "2026-01"; to: "2026-12".
cases.return: ExportFailed; no file is returned. The endpoint answers 500 MSG465: "Không xuất được báo cáo. Vui lòng thử lại."
cases.log: Error: "Could not export the meeting report 2026-01–2026-12" with the database error as cause.

preconditions: The period is valid and the figures are read.
cases.inputs: actorId: <id of an active internal reader>; from: "2026-01"; to: "2026-12".
cases.return: ExportFailed; no file is returned and no export is recorded. The endpoint answers 500 MSG465: "Không xuất được báo cáo. Vui lòng thử lại."
cases.log: Error: "Could not export the meeting report 2026-01–2026-12" with the build error as cause.

preconditions: The period is valid and the file is built.
cases.inputs: actorId: <id of an active internal reader>; from: "2026-01"; to: "2026-12".
cases.return: ExportFailed; no file is returned even though the figures were computed. The endpoint answers 500 MSG465: "Không xuất được báo cáo. Vui lòng thử lại."
cases.log: Error: "Could not export the meeting report 2026-01–2026-12" with the audit error as cause.

preconditions: The caller stops waiting while the export is running.
cases.inputs: actorId: <id of an active internal reader>; from: "2026-01"; to: "2026-12"; cancellation requested.
cases.return: N/A; no file is returned and no export is recorded.
cases.exception: The cancellation escapes to the caller; it is not converted into ExportFailed.
